description: Use after a transaction lands (or fails) to report what actually happened, instead of guessing from logs. For failures it names the failing program and the fix. Reads a confirmed transaction and returns status, fee, every SOL and token balance change by wallet, the programs used, and a decoded failure reason. Inputs: signature: The transaction signature (its id). network (optional): Solana cluster to read. Defaults to "mainnet-beta" (real funds). Cost: 3 free calls, then $0.005 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/explain_transaction.
name: explain_transaction
